messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "tell your doctor if you have any of them so your dose can be checked"
set: ["tell your doctor if you have any of them so your dose can be checked", "tell your doctor if you have diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria", "tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria (PKU)", "tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery", "tell your doctor if you have a thyroid disorder", "tell your doctor if you have type 2 diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have ever had anemia", "tell your doctor if you have ever had diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroiditis", "ask your doctor or pharmacist if you have any questions", "tell your doctor if you also use", "tell your doctor if you have ever had heart problems", "tell your doctor if you have alcoholism or drug addiction", "tell your doctor if you have a muscle weakness condition", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroid nodule"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
